context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “Passover desired, bread remembered, and a disputed hand” preserves a distinct parallel witness source unit within anticipation.

observations.body: At the table Jesus speaks of desire and fulfillment, gives cup and bread, commands remembrance, names covenant blood poured out, and then identifies a betraying hand at the table.
observations.label: Passover desired, bread remembered, and a disputed hand: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, apostles, bread and cups visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read Luke 22:14–23 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This witness selects its own people, actions, words, and sequence around the Crucifixion without explaining every difference from the other witnesses.
payload.title: Passover desired, bread remembered, and a disputed hand
